rationale: M37.21 #611 template-calls contract (F5 lane findings): the template pass emits calls the embedded-script trees cannot express — on:click={inc} bare-identifier handlers, on:submit={() => save()} first-call-target-in-arrow, on:click={box.open} dotted-member callable leaf, {@render row(it)} snippet renders.
